scripts.build:customer: mkdir -p dist && cp -r *.html css js assets *.js *.json icons lib dist 2>/dev/null || echo 'Customer build done'
scripts.build:owner: mkdir -p dist && cp -r *.html css js assets *.js *.json icons lib dist 2>/dev/null && cp dist/owner.html dist/index.html && echo 'Owner build done'
